title: Atomic Energy Commission 'born secret' restricted data

tellings.quote: The Atomic Energy Commission outlined this sort of restricted data where if you were to collect anything that had any radiological features, alpha, beta, gamma radiation, it would be born secret.

plain: In 1946, the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency set up to control nuclear matters, created a category of "restricted data": anything collected that showed alpha, beta or gamma radiation would be "born secret", meaning classified from the moment it existed. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs. He brings it up because, if true, any radioactive material from an unexplained object would have been hidden from the public automatically.
